name: Carousel
summary: A row of slides that scroll sideways. Use for a few related images or cards, never for critical content.

contentLimits.peek: show part of the next card

whenToUse: Browsing related media in limited space.
whenNotToUse: Important content or calls to action.

keyboard: Arrow keys scroll when the visible frame (viewport) is focused.
accessibility.focus: Focus ring on controls and the visible frame (viewport).
notes: Never autoplay without a pause button.
Hide off-screen slides from the tab order.
Each slide has a label such as 2 of 5.
